## Design decisions

- **Closeout vs re-litigation:** the 2026-11-03 work + rulings stand; this run re-verifies at
  head and covers the commit delta rather than redoing the audit wholesale (the full
  committed-config rescan + unfiltered delta scan + targeted sweeps give equivalent coverage).
- **D-R6OSS.1-1 → DONE:** every (a)–(e) item dispositioned by the operator's recorded acts
  (en-masse STAYS ruling; flip; GitHub-side hygiene; CoC declined); the row's verification
  clause is now fully executed — the anonymous-clone install/build leg was the last unrun piece.
- **New committed evidence** under `docs/build/reports/2026-11-11_r6oss-1-verify/` (disposition
  doc + 3 gitleaks JSONs); runbook gains dated status + dispositions sections (append-only).
